title: Dental PPO Plans Starting Amount of the Patient Share on Reprocessed Grace-Period Lines
content:
**Provision.** The amount the patient share on a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after a not-eligible denial made during a premium grace period (a reprocessed grace-period line) starts from follows the network and the filing:
- for a line from an in-network practice received later than 180 calendar days after its date of service, it is 0.00, the practice bearing the amount;
- for a line from an out-of-network practice, it is the billed amount;
- for any other line, it is the allowed amount.

The participating-practice filing limit is 180 calendar days on every Dental PPO plan. An in-network practice is a PPO or Premier in-network practice.

### Boundary on the 180 days (hypothetical in-network line, date of service 1 March of a non-leap year)
| Received | Days after the date of service | Starting amount |
|---|---|---|
| 28 August | 180 | The allowed amount |
| 29 August | 181 | 0.00 |

### Other cases (hypothetical)
- Out-of-network line, billed 410.00, allowed 296.20: starts from 410.00, whenever received.
- In-network line received within 180 days, allowed 296.20: starts from 296.20.
